candidates.description: This feature vector represents coastal, marine, and aquatic environments or bodies of water.
This vector represents common English prepositional and verbal particles often used as phrasal verb components or directional modifiers.
This vector represents common adjectives describing relative difficulty, speed, or subjective qualities of tasks and experiences.
This vector activates on tokens beginning with the letters 'p' or 'P'.
This feature vector activates on tokens and subwords containing the contiguous letter sequence "ul" across various languages and contexts.
This vector represents common Portuguese verb roots and inflections associated with actions, demonstrations, and meanings.
This feature vector activates strongly on the letter sequence "ur" and words containing it.
This feature vector activates on words related to energy, physical capacity, interruption, and resilience or opposition.
This feature vector activates strongly on words, prefixes, and tokens starting with the letters "Su" or "su".
This feature represents non-English or accented characters and diacritical marks commonly found in UTF-8 encodings.
